response: Approve this first-pilot scope and recovery rule
approvedForImplementation: An existing Academy Owner prepares one published attendance register on a personal device.
Local copies contain only session details, roster names and IDs, and attendance marks and versions.
Logout or 30 days without an online access check clears the downloaded rows.
Pending work remains protected. The same account can recover it through normal sign-in while it has current Owner access.
When Owner access ends, pending work stays protected until access is restored.
